title: Paramount-Warner Deal at Risk of Delays That Would Cost Billions
title_zh: 派拉蒙与华纳的交易面临延误风险，损失数十亿美元
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Paramount Skydance Corp. was on the brink of closing its blockbuster $110 billion takeover of Warner Bros. Discovery Inc.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——派拉蒙 Skydance 公司即将完成对华纳兄弟探索公司 1100 亿美元的重磅收购。

title: JPMorgan Chase (JPM) Helps Drive $60 Billion In U.S. Iraq Deals
title_zh: 摩根大通 (JPM) 帮助美国在伊拉克的交易中推动了 600 亿美元的交易
summary: JPMorgan Chase is involved in a series of high profile economic agreements between U.S. companies and Iraq tied to the Iraqi Prime Minister’s recent visit to Washington.
summary_zh: 摩根大通参与了美国公司与伊拉克之间与伊拉克总理最近访问华盛顿有关的一系列备受瞩目的经济协议。

title: AMD stock rises on price target bumps, Microsoft deal
title_zh: AMD 股价因目标价上涨和微软交易而上涨
summary: AMD stock rose more than 3% on Monday.
summary_zh: AMD 股价周一上涨超过 3%。

title: Blackstone Backs Futronic in Deal Valuing Robotics Supplier at $675 Million
title_zh: Blackstone 在机器人供应商交易中支持 Futronic，估值达 6.75 亿美元
summary: Private equity investment supports Futronic's global expansion as Blackstone highlights AI, robotics and automotive growth opportunities.
summary_zh: Blackstone 强调人工智能、机器人和汽车增长机会，私募股权投资支持 Futronic 的全球扩张。

title: Goldman Offers Preferred Stock Days After Post-Crisis Spread Low
title_zh: 高盛在危机后利差低位几天后提供优先股
